Lastly, the health status detection accuracy reached by the studied frequency peaks was investigated. Specific cut-off levels were determined for each frequency peak in order to reach a sensitivity of at least 80%. Consequently, pairs of sensitivity and specificity were calculated. Results showed that the amplitude value, of the frequency peak FFT_P2, reached the best accuracy (specificity = 42.9% and sensitivity = 80.1%, Table 12) with a cut-off level equal to 16.05 dB followed by the frequency value of the frequency peak FFT_P1 (specificity = 39.8% and sensitivity = 80.1%) with a cut-off level equal to 12.00 × 10−3 Hz.
